items.title: Booking Holdings Leaves Priceline Out of B2B Unit Amid FTC Scrutiny
items.snippet: Skift Take: Leaving Priceline out of the B2B consolidation is a blow to the goals of Booking Partner Division. Booking Holdings initially planned to consolidate three of its B2B brands into its new Booking Partner Division, but decided to leave Priceline out because of a potential U.S. Federal Trade Commission complaint against the brand.

items.title: Delta and Hyatt Launch Double Earning for Elite Members
items.snippet: Delta and Hyatt have revived double earning for elite members, offering additional miles, hotel points and future status opportunities, although fare restrictions could limit the benefits for many frequent business travelers.

items.title: Marriott faces technical issues amid flurry of US outages, disruptions
items.snippet: A company spokesperson said tech complications impacted sign-in capabilities on its website and the Marriott Bonvoy app this week, though cybersecurity was a non-factor. Amid a flurry of technology disruptions at some of the country’s biggest companies this week, Marriott International faced its own technical challenges, the company confirmed to Hotel Dive.

items.title: A Back Office That Runs Itself: Automating Hotel Operations in 2027
items.snippet: Otelier whitepaper draws on operator interviews to map which back-office tasks are ready to automate now, from night audit to OTA reconciliation, as GOPPAR growth stalls at 1% in 2027.

items.title: Royal Orchid Hotels Adds 102 Keys Across Rajkot and Vizag
items.snippet: The two launches strengthen the group’s presence in Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh with new business and lifestyle hotels. Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. (ROHL), through its subsidiary Regenta Hotels Private Limited, has opened two properties, Regenta Crystal in Rajkot and Z by Regenta in Visakhapatnam, adding 102 rooms and suites to its portfolio.

items.title: Food Safety Crackdown: Licences of 13 Eateries Suspended in Mumbai and Hyderabad
items.snippet: FDA and TG SAFE inspections uncover hygiene violations across restaurants; establishments face closure, food seizures and possible delisting from online delivery platforms. Food safety authorities in Maharashtra and Telangana have stepped up enforcement against restaurants and food establishments following inspections that revealed serious hygiene and regulatory violations.

items.title: Bulk Scotch imports face 162.5 pc duty and tax amid India-UK trade pact dispute: Report
items.snippet: Bulk Scotch whisky shipments caught in a customs classification dispute under the India-UK free trade agreement (FTA) face a combined duty and tax burden of 162.5 per cent in India, Reuters reported on Wednesday, citing a government document it reviewed and eight sources with direct knowledge of the matter.

items.title: California unveils 2027 lineup of major openings, landmark events and new resorts
items.snippet: California invites travelers to experience rich art and cultural offerings, major sporting events, immersive attractions, new accommodations and more in 2027.

items.title: 10 Experiences That Showcase Spectacular Boston in Winter
items.snippet: Winter in Boston offers a chance to see the city in a new way. Historic neighborhoods have a magic that seems amplified in the cold, the waterfront is filled with festivities, and the city’s restaurants and cultural attractions are an appealing counterbalance to the brisk weather. So that you can make the most of your visit, here’s how to experience a winter escape to Boston, Massachusetts.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group expands loyalty offering, selects India for global launch of Radisson Dining
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group has announced the launch of Radisson Dining in India, a subscription-based dining and lifestyle benefits programme developed in partnership with TLC DigiTech. Available from December 1, 2026, the initiative will extend the group’s Radisson Rewards loyalty ecosystem beyond hotel stays, offering local consumers benefits across dining, spa and accommodation at participating properties.
